reuse.why: The template lookup is factored into getCategoriesWithTemplates, but the existing copied category queries are left as they are and setZero gets yet another hand-written hidden filter.

duplication.why: The same 'if templated.has(id) skip' check and helper call are pasted into five actions, and setZero adds a fourth copy of the hidden/group-hidden SQL filter.

placement.why: The helper sits in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use it; the rule is spread over each action's body rather than one selection.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions plus a release note.

maintainability.why: Changing the eligibility rule again means editing five actions and three or four SQL copies; hidden is decided in SQL in some actions and in JS in copyPreviousMonth.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction for category eligibility in the tree to bypass; the change simply does not create one for the whole rule.

disguised_duplication.where: Repeated checks and the copied hidden filter are plain copies.

one_place.where: Template rule shared via getCategoriesWithTemplates but applied separately in copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg; hidden rule still in each action's own SQL (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) and a JS check in copyPreviousMonth.
